DNA contains 2'-deoxyribose and is alkali-stable; RNA contains D-ribose with a reactive 2'-OH making it alkali-labile. Review all 10 high-yield NEST traps and the complete 63-term master glossary.

summaryBox.title: DNA vs RNA Comparison
summaryBox.takeaway: DNA: 2'-deoxyribose, Thymine, double-stranded, alkali stable. RNA: D-ribose (2'-OH), Uracil, single-stranded, alkali labile.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
DNA vs RNA STRUCTURAL COMPARISON
                          
   PARAMETER             DNA (Deoxyribonucleic Acid)          RNA (Ribonucleic Acid)
   Pentose Sugar         $2'$-Deoxy-$\text{D}$-ribose           $\text{D}$-Ribose (contains reactive $2'-\text{OH}$)
   Pyrimidine Bases      Cytosine ($\text{C}$) and **Thymine ($\text{T}$)** Cytosine ($\text{C}$) and **Uracil ($\text{U}$)**
   Secondary Structure   Double-stranded right-handed helix   Single-stranded (folds into hairpins)
   Alkaline Stability    Highly stable to alkali              Hydrolyzed by alkali due to $2'-\text{OH}$
conceptBreakdown.content: Nucleotides polymerize linearly by joining the 3'-hydroxyl of one pentose sugar to the 5'-phosphate group of the next via a 3',5'-Phosphodiester Linkage.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
10 NEST BIOMOLECULES TRAPS SUMMARY:

1. Sucrose is a NON-REDUCING sugar (both anomeric carbons locked in glycosidic bond).
2. Glycine is the ONLY ACHIRAL standard amino acid.
3. Denaturation destroys 2°, 3°, 4° structures but leaves PRIMARY (1°) peptide bonds INTACT.
4. Fructose reduces Fehling's/Tollens' due to alkaline enolization (Lobry de Bruyn-Ekenstein).
5. Vitamin B₁₂ is a water-soluble vitamin that is STORED in the liver for several years.
6. Cellulose gives a NEGATIVE iodine test (no helical coils to trap I₂).
7. Natural amino acids in proteins belong strictly to the L-configuration.
8. DNA lacks 2'-OH (2'-deoxyribose); RNA contains 2'-OH making it alkali-labile.
9. Invert sugar is LEVOROTATORY (-19.85°) due to fructose levorotation (-92.4°).
10. Vitamin K deficiency causes delayed blood clotting; Vitamin C deficiency causes Scurvy.
